mask.desc: Custom mask or one of the predefined mask names

fill-mask.desc: Fills string with specified characters (or underscore if value is not string) to fill mask's length

reverse-fill-mask.desc: Fills string from the right side of the mask

unmasked-value.desc: Model will be unmasked (won't contain tokens/separation characters)

custom-tokens.desc: Object that contains a function to mask the value. Adds to the list of predefined masks
